description_blocks.text:
140 mm Noctua 12 V, 4-pin PWM fan manufacturer reference for PC and DIY NAS enclosure design. Public STEP CAD is supplied for reference, visualization and integration only. Noctua prohibits manufacture, reproduction or commercialization of the represented fan or substantially similar products; do not use these models for performance simulations or 3D printing. Retain the original ZIP README and consult the linked CAD policy.

Manufacturer CAD for enclosure integration around the purchased fan. The public model represents mounting and external dimensions; impeller and internal frame geometry are deliberately simplified. It is not a production model or a performance-simulation model. Nominal frame size excludes anti-vibration pads; allow the separately listed padded envelope and confirm the physical installation, gasket, fasteners, cable routing and connector clearance. The model filename does not establish the current physical hardware revision. No live price or stock is inferred.
